title: Nuclear maintenance and outage planning
description: Coordinate a planned A-train equipment outage at a fictional reference pressurised-water reactor. Sixteen tasks cover service water, component cooling, electrical work, independent verification, inspection and return-to-service testing. Compare existing crews with a qualified HX contractor against working shifts and a booked inspection window. Both B pumps are protected from planned work. Work scope, durations, qualifications, gates, costs and deadlines are authored exercise assumptions. World supplies the pre-maintenance plant readings.
objectives: Coordinate sixteen tasks across three A-train assets and qualified crews while protecting both B pumps from work.
Compare checked schedules, inspect crew contention and see which handoffs set the finish.
Ask the Assistant whether maintenance can finish by a chosen deadline and inspect its checked schedule or refusal.
Preview an estimate change and optionally calculate heat transport from current pump flow and explicit assumptions.

guide.title: Coordinate the cooling-train maintenance window
guide.description: Three work fronts share qualified crews, a booked inspection slot and work-control handoffs. Compare existing crews with a qualified contractor, then ask the Assistant about a deadline. Scheduled review and acceptance gates are part of the forecast.

steps.title: Can the cooling train return by Wednesday evening?
steps.instruction: Choose Compare maintenance schedules. Work starts Wednesday 18 November at 07:00, with a 21:00 return target. Compare the dated finishes and cost for existing crews or a qualified HX contractor. The plan reads this plant’s pre-maintenance state.

steps.title: See the handoffs and test a deadline
steps.instruction: Select a task in Planning to see its crews, prerequisites and start explanation. Ask the Assistant whether work can finish by 20:00 Wednesday, then try 19:00.
